slides.headline: Master Environment — Midnight Soho to SEPHORA Flagship
slides.narrative_copy: Exterior: Rain-slicked London cobblestones and wet asphalt reflecting neon signage. Interior: High-gloss black lacquer and mirrored vanity aisles bathed in brilliant 5600K beauty lighting. Lighting: Exterior: Moody 3200K tungsten streetlamps with electric magenta and cyan neon rim light. Interior: 5600K high-CRI diffused beauty lighting. Atmosphere: Fine airborne London rain drizzle, water droplets on patent leather, cosmetic shimmer powder catching light. Invariants: The black-and-white SEPHORA shopping bag retains exact vertical stripe geometry and clean typography.; Maya's scarlet trench coat remains high-gloss patent leather without texture drift.; Kaelen's charcoal blazer maintains chalk-white stripe accents without color bleeding.

slides.headline: SC01: The Soho Approach
slides.narrative_copy: Model Maya struts down rain-slicked Soho cobblestones at midnight under glowing neon signage. -> A red double-decker bus streaks past with wet tire spray in the background. -> Maya reaches the glowing glass facade of the SEPHORA flagship, heels clicking firmly on wet stone. Kinetic Chain: Stiletto strike -> Ground reaction force -> Arm swing momentum -> Controlled approach -> Hand touches entrance door handle.

slides.headline: SC02: The Store Transition
slides.narrative_copy: Camera glides backward without jump cuts through opening glass doors into brilliant 5600K beauty light. -> Model Kaelen in charcoal blazer steps into frame alongside Maya. -> Kaelen flicks open a gold lipstick case with a crisp mechanical snap as Maya whispers 'London, wake up.' Kinetic Chain: Door glide momentum -> Footfall cadence unchanged -> Thumb drives lipstick cap removal -> Snappy mechanical disengagement -> Side-by-side synchronized stride.

slides.headline: SC03: The Product Flourish
slides.narrative_copy: Vertical tracking camera arcs 45 degrees to frame Maya from a low-angle three-quarter angle. -> Maya smoothly picks up the striped SEPHORA shopping bag by its braided rope handles in stride. -> The bag swings forward in a controlled arc, catching overhead beauty lights with rigid paper folds. Kinetic Chain: Tracking arc -> Fingers grasp braided rope handle -> Upward impulse lifts bag -> Centrifugal acceleration swings bag forward -> Stable chest-height carry.

slides.headline: SC04: The Climactic Hero Lock
slides.narrative_copy: Camera punches in 50 centimeters directly toward the SEPHORA bag. -> Embossed brand logo locks dead-center at chest height as Maya reaches the outdoor threshold. -> At second 38, motion snaps into a high-fashion freeze-frame on the bag, with neon bokeh behind. Kinetic Chain: Punch-in deceleration -> Arm locks bag upright -> Rope handles hold vertical tension -> Immediate kinetic freeze -> Sustained static frame.
